In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
E6 and E6/E7 of HPV 18 are able to upregulate ABC transporters and that this is mediated by a stabilization of the corresponding mRNA and not a translational regulation.
E6 and/or E7 of HPV18 upregulates the ABC transporters P-gp, MRP1/2, and BCRP via mRNA stabilization and/or translation in oropharynx cancer cell lines.
ABC transporters are up-regulated in HPV+ oropharyngeally cancer cells and this is mediated by HPV18E6 and HPV18E7.
